verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local terminal app for iOS, and its docs state it is entirely open source under the FreeBSD license, so a user can run and control the core product themselves with no vendor-hosted service involved. The evidence does not document building from source, deploying your own builds, or any self-hosting procedure, so the openness is proven but the self-host workflow is not. Missing for 10: documented build-from-source or self-deployment instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a user running their own build.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: a-Shell is entirely OpenSource, and released under the FreeBSD license.
The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
